pages.text: Over a hundred creatures spawn in this world. Next to vanilla's:$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Naturalist$() adds real animals, each in the biomes it belongs in: bears and deer in the woods, elephants, giraffes, lions and zebras on the savanna, alligators in the swamps, whales and sharks at sea, and birds, snakes, butterflies and fireflies.$(br)$(li)$(bold)Friends & Foes$() brings back Mojang's mob-vote creatures: the glare, the mauler, the moobloom, the crab, the rascal, and the iceologer and illusioner illagers.

$(li)$(bold)Creeper Overhaul$() gives most biomes a creeper of their own, each with a trick of its own when it blows.$(br)$(li)$(bold)Variants & Ventures$() adds biome variants of zombies and skeletons.$(br)$(li)$(bold)Ice and Fire$() adds fire, ice and lightning dragons, which live in caves and roosts rather than spawning in the open: see $(l:lemursaucepacket:where-to-find)Where to find things$(/l).$(br)$(li)$(bold)Illager Invasion$() adds new illagers who live in their own forts, towers and huts (see $(l:lemursaucepacket:structures)Structures and dungeons$(/l)), not in the open.

A creature's card lists every biome it spawns in; click one to see that biome. Monsters spawn in the dark almost anywhere, so "spawns in" for them means where they can, not where you'll always meet them.
